statement: Not an independent implementation result (reference code or unstated).

results.title: Capabilities document is served, valid, and marks the draft as not adopted
Well-known lifecycle manifest equals the capabilities document
OLIP 1.0 manifest (if served) advertises the lifecycle extension without changing 1.0 versions
Production hosts expose no mock hooks
results.detail: test build (mock hooks present); re-run against the production build

results.title: Recipient list is alphabetical and states that payment never affects order
Host keys are Ed25519 JWKs with a purpose
Unauthenticated writes are refused with an OLIP error
Unknown operations return 404 with an OLIP error
Responses carry no-store and nosniff headers
User signs in and delegates an assistant; the assistant gets its own token
Assistant can prepare a minimal screening; the response never includes the approval code
The assistant cannot approve (403 OLIP_AGENT_CANNOT_APPROVE) and cannot read the approval page
Nothing is sent before the user approves
After the user approves on the page, the screening is delivered only with the firm's signed receipt
results.detail: delivery=delivered_to_endpoint (approval code read from the mock inbox)

results.title: A used approval cannot be reused (410 OLIP_AUTHORIZATION_EXPIRED)
Mutations without Idempotency-Key are refused
The assistant cannot record a firm's lifecycle event
The matter journal is hash-chained and host attestations verify
Passport export is signed, transmits nothing and authorizes nobody
Every response seen in this run matches the published JSON Schemas
